name: Jartycuck's Basics in Coal and Goonin 2 'p
summary: You have been kidnapped by the Omoribus and taken to Jartycuck's schoolhouse. Now you must collect seven coals to bribe the bus driver into taking you back home. However, this won't be an easy task, as the residents of the Jartycuck Schoolhouse will do anything to stop you from leaving, and you must avoid the owner Jake at all costs.
